description.en: Polite, measured speech suitable for a noble, diplomat or scholar.
description.ru: Сдержанная, благородная манера без вычурного пафоса.
description.fr: Style poli et mesuré, sans emphase excessive.
description.es: Estilo educado y mesurado sin teatralidad excesiva.
description.de: Höflicher, bedachter Stil ohne übertriebenes Pathos.

instructions: Render the final message in a polite, articulate, gently formal register, fitting a noble, diplomat or thoughtful scholar. Make sentence structure elegant but understandable. Avoid archaic 'thee/thou', flowery filler and invented formal greetings unless they genuinely match the input. Preserve exactly what the player meant; change only the style of expression.
recognitionHints: Court, noble, diplomacy, scholar, audience, lord, lady.
